title: Early stopping, LR scheduler, macro-F1 best checkpoint, seed + hyperparam metadata
description: Training hygiene in src/train_classifier.py: --early-stopping patience (monitor val macro-F1), --scheduler {none,cosine,plateau}, best checkpoint selected by val macro-F1 (NOT plain accuracy), deterministic seeding of torch/numpy/random from --seed, checkpoint metadata gains seed + full hyperparams (lr, epochs, batch_size, arch, aug, strategy, scheduler, early-stop, stages, seed) and metrics json logs seed. Existing checkpoint keys (state_dict, class_names, img_size, seed, best_val_metrics, arch, arch_args) preserved.
acceptance_criteria: Early stopping stops training after patience epochs without val macro-F1 gain
Scheduler steps per epoch (cosine/plateau both wired)
Best checkpoint saved on val macro-F1, not accuracy
Same seed → identical split/shuffle init (seeded torch/numpy/random)
Checkpoint metadata contains seed + full hyperparams; backward-compat keys intact
validation: ./.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_training_hygiene.py -q && ./.venv/bin/python src/train_classifier.py --labels data/damage/manifests/train.csv --val-labels data/damage/manifests/val.csv --image-root . --arch custom --epochs 1 --early-stopping 1 --scheduler cosine --seed 42 --aug moderate --strategy sampler --output /tmp/smoke_hygiene.pth --metrics /tmp/smoke_hygiene.json
